run_construct_final_action_dict: run the script to construct final action dictionaries from MTurk annotation tool outputs A through D
collect_tool_outputs: collect and parse tool C and tool D annotation outputs from tab-separated agreement files into in-memory maps
combine_tool_cd_make_ab: combine tool C and D outputs with tool A and B outputs to build unified annotation maps
update_action_dictionaries: update and write combined action dictionaries to a file by cleaning spans, processing repeats, and fixing reference objects
postprocess_step: postprocess combined action dictionaries by fixing PUT_MEMORY actions, handling dialogue targets, and rewriting action types
